newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Government to remove insurance head.
newsitem.headline: French Government to remove insurance head.

text.p: The French government will fire the chairman of state-owned insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales next week if he continues to resist a call for his resignation after a failed bid to privatise a GAN banking subsidiary, a government source said Tuesday.
"There will be a decree ending his mandate," the source said after GAN confirmed that Jean-Jacques Bonnaud was not resigning.
The decree removing Bonnaud would be adopted at a cabinet meeting next week, when a replacement was likely to be named, the source said.
The source said this was standard procedure in a case where the head of a state company would not resign.
Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said last Thursday that he was scrapping a bid to privatise GAN banking unit Credit Industriel et Commercial after getting only one offer.
He accused Bonnaud and CIC head Bernard Yoncourt of not doing enough to promote the privatisation.
